final: WITH g AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 GROUP BY rating) SELECT ord, rating, avg_len, avg_ratio FROM (SELECT 1 AS ord, rating, avg_len, avg_ratio FROM g UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS ord, 'ALL' AS rating, AVG(avg_len) AS avg_len, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM g) ORDER BY ord, rating
